title: Printer offline or not printing
body:
## Symptom
Printer shows offline in Windows; print jobs sit in queue without printing.

## Resolution
1. Confirm printer is powered on and network-connected.
2. Restart the print spooler:
```
net stop spooler
net start spooler
```
3. Clear the print queue and resend the job.

## Related error codes
- 0x00000709

title: VPN client fails to connect
body:
## Symptom
VPN client shows connection failed or times out.

## Resolution
1. Confirm active internet connection.
2. Update VPN client to latest version.
3. Clear VPN client cache: `vpnclient --clear-cache`
4. Reconnect.

## Related error codes
- ERR_VPN_TIMEOUT_017

title: VPN client fails to connect
body:
## Symptom
VPN client shows connection failed or times out.

## Resolution
1. Confirm active internet connection.
2. Update VPN client to latest version.
3. Clear cache via Settings > Network > Reset.
4. Reconnect. Contact network ops if issue persists beyond 3 attempts.

## Related error codes
- ERR_VPN_TIMEOUT_017
- ERR_VPN_AUTH_022

title: Password reset for company portal
body:
## Resolution
1. Go to password.company.com
2. Enter employee ID.
3. Follow the emailed reset link.
4. If self-service fails, contact IT with manager confirmation.

title: Email not syncing across devices
body:
## Symptom
New emails appear on one device but not others; folders out of sync.

## Resolution
1. Verify mailbox storage quota is not full.
2. Confirm IMAP/Exchange server settings match on all devices.
3. Restart the email client.
4. Check spam/junk folder filters per device.

## Related error codes
- SYNC_ERR_0091

title: Software installation request process
body:
## Resolution
1. Standard approved software: install via Company Software Center, no ticket needed.
2. Non-standard software: requires manager approval, then a ticket to IT procurement.
3. Installation typically completes within 1 business day of approval.

title: Monitor display flickering or no signal
body:
## Symptom
External monitor flickers, shows no signal, or resolution resets unexpectedly.

## Resolution
1. Reseat the display cable (HDMI/DisplayPort) at both ends.
2. Update graphics driver via Device Manager.
3. Test with a different cable to rule out a faulty one.
4. If using a docking station, update dock firmware.

## Related error codes
- DISP_NOSIGNAL_04

title: Shared drive access denied
body:
## Symptom
User receives access denied error when opening a shared network drive.

## Resolution
1. Confirm the user's AD group membership includes the correct share permission group.
2. Have the user reconnect the mapped drive (disconnect, remap).
3. If newly hired, allow up to 4 hours for AD group sync to propagate.
4. Escalate to identity team if access is still denied after propagation window.

title: Laptop battery draining rapidly
body:
## Symptom
Battery percentage drops significantly faster than expected under normal use.

## Resolution
1. Check Task Manager for high background CPU usage processes.
2. Run battery report: `powercfg /batteryreport`
3. Review report for battery health/capacity degradation.
4. If capacity is below 60% of design, submit a hardware replacement request.

title: Two-factor authentication (2FA) not receiving codes
body:
## Symptom
User does not receive SMS or app push codes during 2FA login.

## Resolution
1. Confirm phone number on file is correct in the identity portal.
2. Check authenticator app time sync (drift causes code rejection).
3. Request a backup code from IT if device is unavailable.
4. Re-enroll the device if codes still fail after time sync check.

## Related error codes
- MFA_TIMEOUT_003
